body.statement: As an already-known weighted-set-cover corollary, on \(\mathfrak C_{1}\) acquisition is exactly weighted set cover on the \(k\) factor identifiers, and the standard weighted greedy algorithm returns a legal certificate \(E_{\mathrm{gr}}\) satisfying \(\operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{gr}})\le H_k\operatorname{Opt}\). This imports the ordinary cover guarantee and makes no independent novelty claim.
body.justification: This inherited corollary records the sole regime in which the familiar harmonic cover guarantee is valid and prevents it from being attributed to the general physical protocol problem.
body.gap: There is no claimed novelty relative to Akbari, Etesami, and Kiyavash (2025): Lemma 3 on page 8 is the minimum-weight hedge-hitting equivalence, the approximation discussion on page 12 applies greedy minimum-weight hitting set, and Corollary 2 on pages 7--8 records logarithmic inapproximability. The present corollary merely marks the physical restrictions under which that already-known cover logic applies.
body.consumer: Experiment planners with isolated single-assay protocols obtain the familiar harmonic approximation without extrapolating it to protocols with shared-source synergy.
